items.title: What these consumers are paying for fast food, Dollar Menu staples
items.summary: How much have prices risen on these fast food and comfort eats staples? Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma takes to the streets of New York to ask consumers how much their Dollar Menu and pizza orders now cost, and the factors they are noticing that are causing this drive up in prices.

items.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Stock May Be 9% Rich After Traffic Slowdown
items.summary: McDonald's stock has delivered a 29.7% gain over the past five years, yet its current valuation picture is mixed, with an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model that points to the shares sitting close to fair value while market multiples look more generous. Over five years McDonald's has returned 29.7%, which is a solid outcome but not the kind of performance that clearly signals the stock is either stretched or deeply mispriced. items.title: Wall Street week ahead: monthly jobs report, McDonald's and SpaceX earnings
items.summary: Corporate earnings from big U.S. companies and closely-watched jobs reports are among the key updates for Wall Street this week.  The latest batch of profit updates and forecasts could help give investors a clearer picture of how and where households are spending money amid stubbornly high inflation.  Bleach and household products maker Clorox and hotel operator Marriott International report their latest results on Monday.
